title: Source: Cursor, which is prepping for an expected acquisition by SpaceX, passed $4B in annualized revenue in the last week, up from $3B in April and $2B in Feb. (Richard Nieva/Forbes)
summary: Richard Nieva / Forbes: Source: Cursor, which is prepping for an expected acquisition by SpaceX, passed $4B in annualized revenue in the last week, up from $3B in April and $2B in Feb. — Elon Musk's rocket and AI company is expected to acquire the buzzy AI coding startup shortly after it goes public.
